C1836.title: Man Registered 110 Accounts to Defraud Food-Delivery Insurance of Over 25,000 Yuan, Sentenced in Anhui
C1836.summary: From October 2019 to November 2020, defendant Zhao used his own and others' identities plus virtual phone cards to register 110 Meituan accounts, placing 111 food orders on Meituan delivery and claiming "food safety liability insurance" payouts by reporting foreign objects in meals, defrauding over 25,000 yuan in insurance. In December 2021, Dangshan County Court in Anhui sentenced Zhao to nine months' imprisonment (suspended one year) for insurance fraud, plus a 10,000 yuan fine. The case is a typical ruling on exploiting delivery-platform insurance rules for wool-pulling.
